_meta.use: Pre-existing inconsistencies. The Evals fail Cross-Service Coherence on any inconsistency in task-touched data, so keep these records out of a task's scope, or make reconciling them the explicit, incorporated job.
_meta.sources: kb_cache passes over every export (computed) plus Scenario_Atlas.md items re-cited with ids (source=Scenario_Atlas); those were written from the Feb 14, 2026 data, so on another universe a row is kept only when every id it cites resolves there.
checked_and_clean: Slack: 0 orphan reply groups, 0 replies earlier than parent, 0 messages on/after clock, 0 posts by unknown users
Linear: 0 Done without completed_at, 0 Canceled without canceled_at, 0 dates after clock, 0 missing parents/assignees
GitHub: 0 merged without merged_at, 0 merged_at < created_at, every PR comment has a 'commented' timeline event
Confluence: versions contiguous, latest version == page body/title on all 31 pages
Trello: badges.comments/checkItems agree with actions/check items on all 803 cards
GCal: 0 end<=start, every copy has self:true on the owner, 0 instances missing an attendee copy
Drive family: sharing/owner/modified agree between Drive and Docs/Sheets/Slides rows
Snowflake: CASH_BALANCE rolls forward (cash_n = cash_n-1 - monthly_net_burn) for all 34 months; mirrored tables agree row-for-row

temporal.title: Timeline 'reviewed' events have null created_at (and empty actor)
temporal.keep_out_guidance: Never order or date reviews from the timeline; use github_reviews.submitted_at. Do not seed timeline 'reviewed' rows with timestamps unless you also fill the base pattern consistently.

temporal.title: Thread files whose messages are not in chronological order
temporal.keep_out_guidance: Do not let 'the latest message in the thread' be decided by array order; sort by date. Seeded replies must be dated after the parent.

temporal.title: Messages with missing/unparseable date
temporal.keep_out_guidance: Keep these threads out of any date-ordered question.

temporal.title: Linear issue completed more than a day before the first PR that names it was merged
temporal.denominator: 494 issues referenced by a PR title/branch/body
temporal.keep_out_guidance: If a task asks 'when did X ship', define whether Linear completion or PR merge is authoritative, or avoid these issues.

temporal.title: Card has an action later than its dateLastActivity
temporal.keep_out_guidance: When seeding a Trello comment, bump dateLastActivity; avoid these cards for 'last touched' questions.

temporal.title: Storyline YAML artifacts that do not exist in the base (incl. 3 Slack messages dated 2026-02-13 in #prototype)
temporal.keep_out_guidance: Never treat metadata/*.yaml as ground truth; the cited 2026-02-13 #prototype messages are absent from the export.

temporal.title: Confluence edits/comments dated >30 days after the author's last activity anywhere else (synthetic-looking authorship)
examples: douglas@harmonygames.co confluence 2025-12-31 vs other services last 2025-10-24
temporal.keep_out_guidance: Do not use Confluence authorship as evidence that someone was still active; check activity.json first.

semantic_category.title: match3d PRs that cite ENG-#### keys (Domino Delights series) instead of ZOM-###
semantic_category.keep_out_guidance: ENG-n and ZOM-n are different issues; never join on the number alone.

semantic_category.title: Issues whose parent is in another team (cross-team epics: ART/DES children under EPI/ENG parents)
semantic_category.keep_out_guidance: Team-scoped cohorts must say whether children of other-team epics count.

semantic_category.title: Label vocabulary mixes sprint names, release codenames, platforms and categories (249 labels across teams)
semantic_category.keep_out_guidance: Never use a label as a category without an incorporated definition (e.g. 'Baklava Hot Fix' is a release, 'Bug' a type).

semantic_category.title: GitHub user display names that disagree with the person (PERSON_2314 shows 'Ryan' but is Frederick Stone; two logins named 'Calvin Price'; 'Marcus' PERSON_0396)
semantic_category.keep_out_guidance: Resolve GitHub authors through entities.json, never by display name.

semantic_category.title: PAYROLL_ROSTER rows carry an undeclared 'title' key; roster roles disagree with persona briefs (EMPLOYEE_0032 'Josh Dempsey, product' vs Senior Unity Engineer; Frederick is_founder=false vs 'Co-founder')
semantic_category.keep_out_guidance: Do not ask for job titles from Snowflake; if roles matter, cite one authority.

semantic_category.title: Contacts job titles that differ from the roster (Leonard 'Co-founder & CEO' vs Creative Director; Robert 'CPO'; Frederick 'Commercial Lead')
semantic_category.keep_out_guidance: Pick one authority for titles in the prompt.

semantic_category.title: Gemini meeting notes misname the entity ('Robert Incorporated') in the wind-down notes
semantic_category.keep_out_guidance: Keep entity-name questions off this doc.

semantic_category.title: Overlapping / contradictory Confluence pages: page_qa_runbook~page_release_checklist (Jaccard 0.26), page_live_ops_engine~page_liveops_calendar (Jaccard 0.25); page_live_ops_engine blames 'a deploy that leaves the job unscheduled' while page_liveops_calendar blames a generator date bug; page_quest_postmortem body says the auto-deploy 'was left running' while Arthur's comment says it 'stays off'; page_support_playbook insists the lives bug is not the scheduler stall; 0 page versions are flagged synthesized
semantic_category.keep_out_guidance: Two pages stating different root causes as fact fail coherence on presence; use one as the authority by an incorporated rule, or keep both out.

cross_service_referential.title: Slack messages citing Linear keys that do not exist in Linear
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: Do not build a chain through these keys; if seeding a Slack mention, use an existing key.

cross_service_referential.title: Slack messages linking PRs that are not in the GitHub export
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: PR links outside the 16 repos (or deleted PRs) cannot be fetched.

cross_service_referential.title: GitHub notification mails whose subject has the repo name redacted ('[[SOURCE_ORG_0001]-Games/[USERNAME_0351]] ...'): 203 mails; mails naming a PR absent from the export: 0
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: The PR is recoverable only from the Message-ID (<org/repo/pull/N/...@github.com>); do not rely on subject parsing.

cross_service_referential.title: Slack links to Google Docs/Sheets/Slides use Google-native ids (docs.google.com/.../d/1X...) that never equal the export's f_ ids
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: A Slack link never resolves to a Drive record by id; a task must name the file by title or path. Seeded links should mimic this (Google-native id) and be paired with an exact title.

cross_service_referential.title: Branch head_sha values are pre-rewrite SHAs (present only as commit_map.old_sha)
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: Do not ask for the commit at a branch head; use PR head_sha.

cross_service_referential.title: GitHub-app Slack mirrors with no matching GitHub comment text (per PR, first 20 normalised chars; heuristic, includes CodeRabbit multi-part renders)
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: A PR whose Slack mirror says more than GitHub (or vice versa) cannot carry a 'what did the review say' requirement; seed both sides together.

cross_service_referential.title: GitHub PR comments (inside a mirrored repo's window) with no Slack mirror copy
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: Mirror coverage is not 100%; do not claim 'every comment is in Slack'.

cross_service_referential.title: Dated calendar-invitation mails (Invitation/Updated/Canceled) with no GCal instance of the same summary within +/-1 day
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: Invites and calendars were exported separately; an invite mail does not prove a GCal row exists (and vice versa). Seed both, or neither.

cross_service_referential.title: Linear 'auto-closed ... changed the status to Canceled' mails whose issue is not Canceled in Linear
cross_service_referential.keep_out_guidance: Linear state at the clock wins over notification mail; avoid these issues if a task reads the mails.

quantitative.title: Thread parent reply_count != replies in export
quantitative.keep_out_guidance: Keep these two threads out of 'how many replies' questions; when seeding replies, update reply_count/reply_users_count/latest_reply together.

quantitative.title: Thread parent latest_reply != newest reply ts
Raw-shaped thread parents with no reply_count/latest_reply at all (counter fields absent)
quantitative.keep_out_guidance: Thread size for these parents must be counted from replies, not read from a field.

quantitative.title: MONTHLY_BURN total != FINANCE_LEDGER outflows for the month
quantitative.keep_out_guidance: Burn questions for 2023-09 have two answers; avoid or name the table.

quantitative.title: Snowflake CASH_BALANCE vs P&L sheets month-end cash differ by ~$33-37K in Sep-Nov 2025 (157,538 vs 194,133; 99,701 vs 137,855; 52,965 vs 85,868); the Jan-2026 P&L breaks internally (Dec end 52,686 vs Jan start 29,636)
quantitative.keep_out_guidance: System-vs-system: keep cash questions on ONE named source or make reconciliation the explicit job.

quantitative.title: Vendor amounts quoted three ways: Helpshift balance $1,500/$1,200/$300; Sunset fee $11.7K/$13-15K/~$15K; Unity ~2.348x9 vs 1,200/mo; AWS ~$1k vs $1,550 vs $1,485 vs 0
quantitative.keep_out_guidance: Human claims vs records are legitimate A1 traps only if the task defines which record is authoritative.

quantitative.title: UA claims vs warehouse: '$50K Adjoe / 10K installs' vs $46,202 / 8,730; 'CPI ~$5' vs Jan $7.02; Meta Feb receipts ~$1,257 vs ledger $956.45

Mirrored warehouse tables checked row-by-row (AD_SPEND_DAILY/AD_SPEND/UA_SPEND_UNIFIED_V2, REVENUE_DAILY/_V2, DAU/DAILY_METRICS_AGG, HEADCOUNT/PAYROLL_ROSTER, APP_STORE_REVIEWS/STORE_REVIEWS, IAP/STORE_TRANSACTIONS): disagreeing pairs listed in examples (empty = all agree)
quantitative.keep_out_guidance: Mirrors agree, so a seeded row must be written to every mirror (and table comments that quote counts updated).

quantitative.title: Same RFC message stored in 2+ mailboxes but with different content
quantitative.keep_out_guidance: Differences are mostly Google-Groups footers, quoted-history truncation and differential redaction ('Harmony Games' vs [SOURCE_ORG_0001]); quote a mail from the persona's own copy only.

quantitative.title: Calendar copies of one instance (same ical_uid + start) that disagree (first differing field counted)
quantitative.keep_out_guidance: Read the persona's own copy; never assert attendee lists or summaries from another calendar's copy.

state_lifecycle.title: Issue in state PR but a referencing PR merged
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: Keep these issues out of cohorts whose predicate is 'shipped' or 'open'.

state_lifecycle.title: Issue Canceled but a referencing PR merged
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: Keep these issues out of cohorts whose predicate is 'shipped' or 'open'.

state_lifecycle.title: Issue Todo/Backlog but a referencing PR merged
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: Keep these issues out of cohorts whose predicate is 'shipped' or 'open'.

state_lifecycle.title: Issue Done but every referencing PR unmerged
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: Keep these issues out of cohorts whose predicate is 'shipped' or 'open'.

state_lifecycle.title: Completed_at set but state not Done
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: Exclude from state-based cohorts or define the rule explicitly.

state_lifecycle.title: Parent Done while child open
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: Exclude from state-based cohorts or define the rule explicitly.

state_lifecycle.title: State 'PR' (awaiting merge)
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: Exclude from state-based cohorts or define the rule explicitly.

state_lifecycle.title: Open issues assigned to people who are quiet/departed at the clock (per activity.json)
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: An 'owner' requirement on these issues points to someone who cannot act; seeded follow-ups must not come from them.

state_lifecycle.title: Merged PRs with no review at all
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: Avoid 'was it approved' criteria unless the review rule is incorporated.

state_lifecycle.title: Merged PRs whose only reviews are bot or COMMENTED (no human APPROVED)
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: As L09; CodeRabbit (PERSON_6026, type Organization) reviews are not human approvals.

state_lifecycle.title: Card in Done list with incomplete checklist items
Work merged after the shutdown announcement (Combo-Fighters#37 merged 2026-02-13 by Oliver; CodeRabbit comment after cancellation); 16 repos never archived; 275 Linear issues still open
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: 'Everything stopped on Feb 9' is false; define the cut-off explicitly.

state_lifecycle.title: Warehouse rows 'completed' where Slack reports outages (EVT-0324/0325 29 Jun 2025; EVT-0592 27 Oct; EVT-0608/0625/0640/0656 Nov leaderboards)
state_lifecycle.keep_out_guidance: System-vs-claim: allowed only if the task makes reconciling them the job.

identifier_format.title: Raw-shaped Slack records (no id, no reply_count; blocks + client_msg_id + user_profile)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Collision-check (channel, ts) before seeding; their DB id is not exported.

identifier_format.title: Message id != sha256(channel|ts)[:32]
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Mint ids with the sha rule anyway.

identifier_format.title: Thread file name uses a mailbox alias different from user_email (leonard@ -> leonard.hayes@, blake@ -> arthur.blake@, jlawson@ -> julia.lawson@ ...)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Search by both alias and roster address.

identifier_format.title: Mixed date formats (RFC-2822 vs ISO-Z) across messages
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Normalise before comparing; seeded rows follow the sibling's format.

identifier_format.title: Mailboxes whose owner is a token (EMPLOYEE_0011_EMAIL, EMPLOYEE_0020_EMAIL, EMPLOYEE_0032_EMAIL, SVC_0009_EMAIL, SVC_0019_EMAIL, SVC_0293_EMAIL)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: No persona can read these; do not place evidence there.

identifier_format.title: Bot comments whose author_login differs from the paired timeline actor_login (CodeRabbit PERSON_6026 vs SVC_0321; linear[bot] PERSON_6028 vs SVC_0323)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: A seeded bot comment must copy this split exactly; counting 'comments by X' differs by table.

identifier_format.title: GitHub logins are tokens; the Slack GitHub-app mirror shows real logins (EMPLOYEE_0025 -> arthur.blake, PERSON_5877 -> owen.baker, PERSON_0396 -> MarcusBennett)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Seeded mirrors must use the real login style; seeded GitHub rows the token.

identifier_format.title: GitHub-app mirror copies with the org redacted ('[SOURCE_ORG_0001]-Games/...')
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Search for repo names, not the org string.

identifier_format.title: Linear user ids that are not usr_<16hex> ('usr_Victor Barnes' with a space, 'usr_Robert', 'usr_Lucas', 'usr_EMPLOYEE_0024')
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Quote ids exactly; never derive them.

identifier_format.title: Same calendar holds two rows for one meeting start (recurring master with rrule + a standalone instance row)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Counting meetings by rows double-counts; count by (ical_uid, start) per calendar.

identifier_format.title: ical_uid + start shared by different meetings (summary differs between copies)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Never join calendar copies on ical_uid alone.

identifier_format.title: Instances with a copy on a calendar whose owner is not an attendee
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Visibility != invitation; do not infer attendance from presence on a calendar.

identifier_format.title: owner_email is not an email ('Resource: -6481757892984311338', 'Resource: 7240535625619857401' ...)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Resource-owned files with empty sharing (2245) are readable by no persona.

identifier_format.title: Drive name keeps the source extension while the Docs/Sheets title does not ('Creative Concepts.docx' vs 'Creative Concepts')
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Search both forms; a seeded native file should follow the same split. Sharing, owner and modified_time agree on all 633 docs, 398 sheets and 164 slides.

identifier_format.title: Action ids whose embedded timestamp != action date (Welcome Board template rows)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Mint Trello ids from the record's own time.

identifier_format.title: Trello list names and members redacted to tokens ('[PERSON_NAME_35449]' lists on DD Product Roadmap; Leonard is PERSON_6094_TRELLO_USER_ID)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: Name lists by id in tasks.

identifier_format.title: In-place retractions written as ~strikethrough~ (claims withdrawn inside the same message)
identifier_format.keep_out_guidance: A struck-through clause is not a live claim; never quote it as one.
